messages:
Alex: Quick sync 1: Orion pre-renewal QBR incoming. Need a compact package: 60/90d spend forecast, renewal-risk slide, and a single-page ops ask. Who can take each?
Priya: I can coordinate. Dan for forecast, Marta for prompt patterns/cost hotspots, Leah for renewal risk & account notes. Shane can prep the enablement demo.
Dan: Ill pull 60/90d token burn + a scenario set (base, activation bump, optimization). Expect CSV by EOD. Current quick numbers: MRR ~$12.4k, avg tokens/day ~1.2M, est monthly inference ~$3.6k.
billing-bot: Forecast CSV uploaded: /team-shared/orion/forecasts/1801234567.csv
Marta: I'll sample 1k recent requests and surface top families. My bet: bulk embedding jobs, long transcript summarization, and multi-shot email generation. Will tag prompt templates with avg token length.
Leah: On renewal side 0: product usage looks healthy but theyre sensitive to surprise spend. Renewal probability ~70% in the pipe; main blocker = dev bandwidth to optimize. They asked about temporary quota bump during a paid pilot.
Priya: For the QBR one-pager, include 3 asks: (1) temporary quota bump (if needed), (2) 2 sprints dev for prompt rework, (3) enablement demo on batching + caching. Also include alert thresholds.
Shane: I can run a 20-min batching + caching demo Wed 11am PT. Ping me if we need to change.
ops-bot: Prep meeting scheduled 1: Orion QBR prep Wed 11:00 PT. Invite sent.
Dan: CSV will include scenario snippet. Quick preview:
```
Scenario,EstMonthlyCost,Notes
Base,$3,600,Current usage
Activation+25%,$4,500,Seasonal activation
Optimized-15%,$3,060,After batching/quant
```
Marta: I'll produce a short mitigation playbook with concrete steps: throttle windows, prefix caching, scheduled embedding jobs, and prompt templates trimmed to essentials. Will put playbook at /team-playbooks/orion-costs.md and link it in the one-pager.
Priya: Also set console alerts: +10% MTD and +25% absolute. Tag account team and on-call.
Marta: Alerts set and owner tagged.
Leah: I'll draft the renewal slide with adoption blockers and suggested CS asks (quota bump + dev support). Will post WIP in #customer-docs by tomorrow.
Dan: Adding a 2-question pre-demo survey to the deck: 1) Which features can tolerate lower fidelity? 2) Which jobs can move to nightly windows? Capture answers during enablement.
Alex: Nice. Final: capture two example prompts theyd accept lower fidelity on and include in the QBR appendix. If anyone sees unexpected spikes in the next 48h, alert here and well escalate. :thumbsup:
